'''Andreas Dress''' (26 August 1938 – 23 February 2024) was a German mathematician specialising in [[geometry]], [[combinatorics]] and [[mathematical biology]].

==Biography==
Dress earned his PhD from the [[University of Kiel]] in 1962, under the supervision of [[Friedrich Bachmann]] and [[Karl-Heinrich Weise]]. His thesis is entitled ''Konstruktion metrischer Ebenen''.<ref name="MGP">{{mathgenealogy|id=24752|name=Andreas Dress}}</ref>

Dress was a professor of mathematics at [[Bielefeld University]] beginning in 1969.<ref name="IAS">{{cite web | title=Andreas Dress | website=Institute for Advanced Study | date=31 August 1974 | url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/andreas-dress | access-date=24 April 2018}}</ref> He was the first director of the [[Max Planck Society|Max Planck Partner Institute]] for Computational Biology in Shanghai.<ref name="mpiobit">{{cite web|url=https://www.mis.mpg.de/news/andreas-dress-passed-away|publisher=Max Planck Institute|title=Obituary {{!}} We mourn the loss of our external scientific member Andreas Dress | date=29 February 2024|access-date=11 March 2024}}</ref> In 1998 he was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Berlin.<ref>{{cite book|author=Dress, Andreas|author2=Terhalle, Werner|chapter=The tree of life and other affine buildings|title=Doc. Math. (Bielefeld) Extra Vol. ICM Berlin, 1998, vol. III|year=1998|pages=565–574|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011611000}}</ref>

Dress died on 23 February 2024, at the age of 85.<ref name="mpiobit"/>
